parameters.note: Griff Creek is a tributary of Lake Tahoe (it originates on Martis Peak and flows south into Lake Tahoe at Kings Beach, Placer Co.). It is not listed by its own name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), but it falls under the Lake Tahoe tributaries entry §7.50(b)(152)(A), which applies to 'Tahoe Lake tributaries upstream to the first lake' — here the entire creek, since no lake lies on the main stem. Per §7.50(a)(1), waters listed in subsection (b) are closed to all fishing except during the shown open season, so the creek is closed Oct. 1 through the Friday preceding the Saturday before Memorial Day. Date_spec encodes 'Saturday preceding Memorial Day' as the last Monday of May (Memorial Day) minus 2 days, since the resolver has no anchor_holiday implementation.

candidates.summary: Open catch-and-release only, Saturday before Memorial Day through Sept. 30; closed to all fishing the rest of the year (Lake Tahoe tributary special regulation).
